select_contact_to_chat: Select a contact to start chatting
create_first_identity: Create your first identity to get started
identity_qr_desc: Share this QR code with friends so they can add you
scan_qr_hint: Select an image file containing a friend's identity QR code
scan_qr_desktop: Pick QR code image from file
scan_qr_mobile: Use camera to scan QR code
qr_scan_fail: Could not recognize QR code, please try again
enter_name_for_friend: Please enter a name for your friend

restart_hint: ⚠️ Node config has been modified. Restart the app for changes to take effect.
